A split infographic contrasting the modes of production in Capitalism vs Socialism. Left side (Capitalism): A factory building with a sign "Private Co." A single wealthy businessman in a suit holds a large bag of money (Profit), while three workers in hard hats receive small coins (Wages). Right side (Socialism): A similar factory with a sign "State Owned." A government official collects the money and channels it into pipes leading to a "Free Hospital" and a "Public School", while workers receive moderate, equal-sized bags of coins.

A triangle/pyramid diagram illustrating the Feudal System. The pyramid is divided into four horizontal layers. Top layer: a King wearing a crown. Second layer: wealthy lords and nobles. Third layer: Knights in armour. Bottom layer, which is the widest: poor farmers with hoes. Downward arrows read "Grants land"; Upward arrows read "Provides loyalty/labour".
